title: 开展背景研究
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/03_APB - Conducting Background Research.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/03_APB - Conducting Background Research/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在图书馆书桌前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits at a library desk with stacks of closed books and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲背景调研和研究论文写作。

shots.scene: 放大镜、书本、笔、对勾四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a magnifying glass, a stack of books, a pen and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 找得准、读得透、写得清、引得对。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着空白文档发呆，旁边堆满打印纸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at a blank document on a laptop screen, surrounded by messy piles of printed pages.
shots.narration: 阿杰要写论文，资料一大堆，无从下笔。

shots.scene: 阿杰想把一大段网页文字直接粘进文档，小研摇头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student is about to paste a large block of copied text into his document; the female graduate student shakes her head beside him.
shots.narration: 他想直接复制粘贴，小研赶紧拦住。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 写论文，有一套靠谱的方法。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着一本打开的书，书上浮现对勾
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over an open book with small check marks floating above the pages. No people.
shots.narration: 背景调研，先弄清别人已经知道什么。

shots.scene: 书本、路标、实验烧瓶三个图标连成一条路
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a book, a signpost and a lab flask connected along a path. No people.
shots.narration: 加深理解，知道去哪找，规划下一步实验。

shots.scene: 小研把整齐的论文递给老周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a neatly bound paper to the older man, who reads it with interest.
shots.narration: 规范的写作，让别人看懂你的知识。

shots.scene: 阿杰面前几个主题气泡，他圈住其中一个
shots.prompt_en: Several topic bubbles with plant and crop icons float in front of the young male student; he circles one of them.
shots.narration: 先选一个自己真正感兴趣的题目。

shots.scene: 一株作物图标旁边是根部肿瘤状的细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a crop plant next to a small rod-shaped soil bacterium icon with an arrow pointing into the plant. No people.
shots.narration: 这次的题目：一种经农杆菌改良的作物。

shots.scene: 主题气泡周围冒出几个问号
shots.prompt_en: One topic bubble surrounded by several question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 围绕它，写下你想弄清的问题。

shots.scene: 漏斗图标把宽泛的问题收窄成一个点
shots.prompt_en: A funnel icon narrowing many wide arrows into one focused point. No people.
shots.narration: 然后收窄焦点，只研究一个主题。

shots.scene: 一根粗线贯穿几张论文页
shots.prompt_en: A thick colored thread running through several blank paper pages. No people.
shots.narration: 论点句，是整篇论文的骨架。

shots.scene: 引言页上一句话被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank page with one highlighted line near the top. No people.
shots.narration: 用一句话说出论文的主旨，写在引言里。

shots.scene: 论点句下面分出三根箭头指向三个要点框
shots.prompt_en: One highlighted line with three arrows branching down to three blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 它告诉读者，后面会怎样展开。

shots.scene: 研究问题的问号变成一个宽泛的回答
shots.prompt_en: A question mark icon turning into a broad speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 论点来自对研究问题的初步回答。

shots.scene: 阿杰把论点句划掉，改写了一遍，又改了一遍
shots.prompt_en: The young male student crosses out a line on a blank draft and rewrites it, then revises it again.
shots.narration: 随着调研深入，论点会一改再改。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 论点不断修改，是正常的，也是应该的。

shots.scene: 一张多级提纲：大标题、小标题、细节
shots.prompt_en: A blank outline page with indented levels shown as lines and bullets, no words. No people.
shots.narration: 研究提纲，帮你理清思路。

shots.scene: 提纲变成一张地图，路线从起点到终点
shots.prompt_en: The outline page turns into a simple map with a dotted route from start to finish flag. No people.
shots.narration: 它像路线图，一步步带你写完论文。

shots.scene: 两种提纲图标：短语式和句子式
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: an outline with short bars and an outline with long lines. No people.
shots.narration: 提纲可写成主题式或句子式，不含引言结论。

shots.scene: 一张卡片上：书名条、几行摘要
shots.prompt_en: A blank index card showing a reference line on top and a few short summary lines below. No people.
shots.narration: 注释书目：每条文献附上简短说明。

shots.scene: 阿杰把卡片按主题分成几摞
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sorts small blank index cards into several piles on the desk.
shots.narration: 写清它讲什么、和题目有何关系、靠不靠谱。

shots.scene: 资料卡和笔记卡图标，旁边是日历
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a source card and a note card next to a calendar with one date circled. No people.
shots.narration: 也可用资料卡和笔记卡，按时提交。

shots.scene: 期刊、教材、政府和大学建筑图标排成一排，都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a row with green checks: a journal, a textbook, a government building and a university building. No people.
shots.narration: 引用要选可信来源：期刊、教材、官方出版物。

shots.scene: 一个网页被很多只手随意修改的图标，打上黄色警示
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a web page being edited by many hands at once, with a yellow caution mark. No people.
shots.narration: 人人可改的网站，不能作为引用来源。

shots.scene: 网页图标指向一本期刊，箭头表示顺藤摸瓜
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a web page with an arrow leading to a stack of journals. No people.
shots.narration: 它只适合作起点，帮你找到正式文献。

shots.scene: 论文末尾的参考文献表，一条条整齐排列
shots.prompt_en: The last page of a paper showing a neat numbered reference list as lines. No people.
shots.narration: 参阅过、引用过的来源，

shots.scene: 每条文献旁打勾，没有遗漏
shots.prompt_en: Each line of a reference list has a green check beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 都要按规定格式列进参考文献表。

shots.scene: 一个人把别人的文章贴上自己名字的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a hand putting its own name tag on someone else's paper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 把别人的文字当成自己的，是故意抄袭。

shots.scene: 一段话没有标注来源，旁边是问号
shots.prompt_en: A paragraph of lines with no citation mark at the end and a red question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 忘了注明出处，也算无意抄袭。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，身后两个抄袭图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head in front of two crossed-out copying icons.
shots.narration: 两种都不道德，科学界都不容许。

shots.scene: 文中括号标注和参考文献表两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sentence ending with a small bracket citation and a reference list page. No people.
shots.narration: 文中标注加文末列表，就能预防。

shots.scene: 一句话加上引号，后面跟着小标注
shots.prompt_en: A short line of text inside quotation marks followed by a small bracket mark. No people.
shots.narration: 借用别人的话或观点，注明出处就可以。

shots.scene: 短引文放在引号里，长引文单独缩进成段
shots.prompt_en: Two examples side by side: a short quote in quotation marks within a line, and a long indented block of lines. No people.
shots.narration: 短的加引号，长的单独成段。

shots.scene: 标注里三个小图标：人像、日历、页码
shots.prompt_en: A bracket containing three small icons: a person, a calendar and a page number symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 都要写明作者、年份和页码。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻阅一本空白的格式手册
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through a blank style manual at the desk.
shots.narration: 拿不准时，查格式手册或在线写作指南。

shots.scene: “我”“我们”代词气泡被打叉，第三人称图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Speech bubbles with first-person pointing hands crossed out, next to a neutral third-person icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 科学写作用第三人称，不用我、我们。

shots.scene: 缩写和表情符号气泡被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Bubbles with shortened words and slang emoji crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不用缩略、简写和俚语，句子完整。

shots.scene: 一个物种学名下的斜体线条示意
shots.prompt_en: A line of text shown slanted in italics next to a small plant icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物学名用斜体。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿红笔在初稿上圈改
shots.prompt_en: The young male student marks corrections on a blank printed draft with a red pen.
shots.narration: 初稿写完，编辑修改是必经一步。

shots.scene: 检查清单：拼写、语法、清晰三项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with three green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 查拼写、语法，看表达清不清楚。

shots.scene: 论点在上，要点和论据像树枝一样支撑
shots.prompt_en: A tree diagram: one top box supported by branches of smaller boxes below. No people.
shots.narration: 要点撑得住论点吗？论据够不够？

shots.scene: 论文三段结构：引言、正文、结论
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked blocks labeled only by icons: a door, a thick book body and a finish flag. No people.
shots.narration: 引言、正文、结论齐不齐，再通读一遍。

shots.scene: 笔记本上三处荧光笔标记和一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with three highlighted lines and a question mark in the margin. No people.
shots.narration: 划出三条要点，连上旧知识，写下疑问。

shots.scene: 日历上几周的格子里依次是放大镜、卡片、初稿图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar of several weeks with icons placed in order: a magnifying glass, index cards and a draft page. No people.
shots.narration: 接下来几周：调研、注释书目、写初稿。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研交换论文互相阅读
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student exchange drafts and read each other's papers.
shots.narration: 然后和同伴互相评阅。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现放大镜、提纲和论点线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a magnifying glass, an outline page and a thread through pages.
shots.narration: 选好题、立论点、列提纲。

shots.scene: 期刊图标打勾，开放网站图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a journal with a green check and an open web page with a yellow question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 用可靠来源，参考文献一个不漏。

shots.scene: 引号和括号标注图标，抄袭图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of quotation marks and a bracket citation with a green check; a copying icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 注明出处，杜绝故意和无意抄袭。

shots.scene: 红笔和打勾清单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a red pen and a checklist with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 第三人称写作，反复编辑修改。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一本装订好的论文挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a neatly bound paper and waves goodbye at the camera in a library.
shots.narration: 严谨调研，诚信写作，下次见！
